findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 7 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 20 questions numbered 1-20; by section: 7.1 2, 7.2 5, 7.3 4, 7.4 2, 7.4.1 2, 7.4.2 5.

Factorial equations, the nPr theorem with the reason for 0! = 1, conditional arrangements (restricted places, blocks, gaps), alike objects, circular arrangements of both kinds, the nCr formula and its corollaries, complementary combinations, diagonals, committees with conditions and real-life counts (PINs, lotteries, song lists). New numbers and situations; no exercise question or book example repeated. Book corrections followed. Every step was checked by computation (formulas and brute-force listing in Python).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
